title.fa: اسپینوزا: جبر، توهم اختیار و نظریهٔ عواطف
title.en: Spinoza: determinism, the illusion of free will and the theory of the affects
title.nl: Spinoza: determinisme, de illusie van vrije wil en de affecten

summary.fa: در نظام اسپینوزا همه‌چیز با ضرورت از طبیعت خدا برمی‌آید و اختیار آزاد توهمی است برخاسته از ناآگاهی به علت‌ها؛ آزادی واقعی یعنی فهم و تسلط عقلانی بر عواطف.
summary.en: In Spinoza's system everything follows by necessity from God's nature and free choice is an illusion born of ignorance of causes; real freedom means understanding and rational mastery of the emotions.
summary.nl: Bij Spinoza volgt alles uit noodzaak en is vrije wil een illusie; echte vrijheid is inzicht in en beheersing van de affecten.

text.fa: زنجیرهٔ علت و معلول در جهان اسپینوزا به همان اندازه ضروری است که استنتاج منطقی؛ هیچ امر «ممکنی» جز آنچه ضرورت طبیعت الهی تعیین کرده نیست.
text.en: In Spinoza's world the chain of cause and effect is as necessary as logical deduction; nothing is merely possible beyond what the necessity of the divine nature fixes.
text.nl: In Spinoza's world the chain of cause and effect is as necessary as logical deduction; nothing is merely possible beyond what the necessity of the divine nature fixes.

text.fa: باور به اختیار از آن‌جا می‌آید که ما کارهای خود را می‌دانیم اما علت‌های واقعی‌شان را نه.
text.en: Belief in free will arises because we are aware of our actions but ignorant of their true causes.
text.nl: Belief in free will arises because we are aware of our actions but ignorant of their true causes.

text.fa: کتاب تأکید می‌کند که اسپینوزا «خواهش» را ذات انسان و لذت را گذر به کمال بیشتر می‌داند و دربارهٔ عشق، حسادت، امید و ترس تحلیل‌هایی روان‌شناختی و شگفت‌انگیز امروزی دارد؛ امید بدون ترس نیست و ترس بدون امید.
text.en: The book stresses that he treats desire as the essence of humans and joy as a passage to greater perfection, with strikingly modern psychological analyses of love, jealousy, hope and fear; hope never comes without fear, nor fear without hope.
text.nl: The book stresses that he treats desire as the essence of humans and joy as a passage to greater perfection, with strikingly modern psychological analyses of love, jealousy, hope and fear; hope never comes without fear, nor fear without hope.

text.fa: به روایت کتاب، «عشق عقلانی به خدا» نقطهٔ اوج اخلاق اوست؛ نویسنده آن را با تعریف عشق به‌عنوان لذتِ همراه علت بیرونی ناهماهنگ می‌یابد، و خدا هم قرار نیست این عشق را پاسخ دهد.
text.en: As the book presents it, the intellectual love of God is the summit of his ethics; the author finds it at odds with his definition of love as joy joined to an external cause, and God is not supposed to love back.
text.nl: As the book presents it, the intellectual love of God is the summit of his ethics; the author finds it at odds with his definition of love as joy joined to an external cause, and God is not supposed to love back.

text.fa: جبرگرایی سخت اسپینوزا در فلسفهٔ معاصر یکی از چند موضع در بحث اختیار است؛ بسیاری سازگارگرایی را برمی‌گزینند، و برداشت کتاب از خودکشی و از «غیرواقعی بودن» خطا فشرده و ساده‌شده است.
text.en: Spinoza's strict determinism is one of several positions in the contemporary free-will debate (many prefer compatibilism), and the book's treatment of suicide and of error as mere privation is compressed and simplified.
text.nl: Spinoza's strict determinism is one of several positions in the contemporary free-will debate (many prefer compatibilism), and the book's treatment of suicide and of error as mere privation is compressed and simplified.
